meta.parties: Silva Et Al. v. Ismail Et Al

rules.statement: Where in a conveyance the specific dimensions of the premises sold are given at the beginning of the schedule, those specific dimensions must control the description given at the end of the schedule.
rules.supporting_quote: All that in a conveyance the specific dimensions of the premises sold are given at the beginning of the schedule, those specific dimensions must control the description given at the end of the schedule.
